ayahealthcare-ayahealthcare:greenhouse:7.title: Corporate Counsel (Litigation)
ayahealthcare-ayahealthcare:greenhouse:7.description: Join Aya Healthcare, winner of multiple Top Workplace awards! The Corporate Counsel will provide legal expertise in matters relating to the operation of Aya Healthcare with a focus on handling employment and wage and hour matters. This position requires exceptional communication and detail orientation in a fast-paced environment. Who We Are: We’re an $8+ billion dollar , rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform. At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally. Responsibilities: Counsel internal clients on various nationwide employment matters, including wage and hour issues, reasonable accommodations, internal investigations, benefits, and employee classification; Draft, review and provide guidance on employment and HR-related policies and procedures; Provide counsel and guidance for the successful defense of lawsuits, claims, charges, filed against the Company; provide informed cost benefit analysis when identifying risks; and select and recommend alternative methods of dispute resolution, when appropriate. Monitoring new developments and emerging issues in various employment and wage and hour laws, assessing related legal risks, and advising various business departments on these Provide timely, business-focused advice to all departments, including compliance, human resources, marketing, and IT to achieve business objectives, mitigate risks, and meet legal Required Qualifications: Must be admitted to the State Bar of California and in good standing Must have J.D. from ABA-accredited law school 5+ years' experience in employment and wage and hour matters Strong research and project management / implementation skills Experience in healthcare, staffing, or services industry a plus Preferred prior experience at a mid to large sized law firm, in-house legal department or some combination thereof Ability to work accurately in fast-paced environment and maintain a sense of urgency Exceptional attention to detail Strong negotiation skills Excellent interpersonal relations What We Offer: Free premium medical, dental, life and vision insurance Generous 401(k) match Aya also offers other benefits to those that are eligible and where required by applicable law, including reimbursements and discretionary bonuses Aya provides paid sick leave in accordance with all applicable state, federal, and local laws. Aya’s general sick leave policy is that employees accrue one hour of paid sick leave for every 30 hours worked. Unlimited DTO — we believe in time off! jobgether-jobgether:lever:8001be29-8f19-.title: RVP, Enterprise Sales
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8001be29-8f19-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a RVP, Enterprise Sales based in United States. This is a senior sales leadership opportunity focused on driving enterprise growth across the Eastern U.S. region. You will lead a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives and Regional Directors while shaping regional go-to-market strategy. The role combines strategic planning, executive-level customer engagement, pipeline management, and hands-on sales leadership. You will be responsible for expanding the customer base, increasing market and wallet share, and consistently delivering ambitious revenue targets. Success will require close collaboration with Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Marketing, Support, and channel partners. You will also play a key role in developing the next generation of sales leaders within a fast-growing, AI-driven cybersecurity environment. This is an opportunity to influence large enterprise accounts and contribute directly to business growth at significant scale. Define and execute the regional go-to-market strategy, ensuring the team consistently meets or exceeds quarterly and annual revenue targets. Lead and develop a regional organization of Enterprise Account Executives and Regional Directors, providing coaching, direction, and accountability. Build and execute strategic account and territory plans designed to increase market share, expand existing relationships, and capture additional customer spend. Develop strategies to grow the regional customer base and identify high-value new business opportunities. Maintain accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly forecasts while driving strong pipeline visibility and operational discipline. Establish best practices around pipeline management, sales methodology, account planning, and deal execution. Coach teams using structured enterprise sales frameworks, including MEDDPICC and Force Management principles. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, prospects, and senior executive stakeholders, including C-level decision-makers. Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Marketing, Support, and other cross-functional teams to accelerate deals, adoption, and revenue growth. Develop and execute partner and channel strategies that generate incremental regional revenue. Identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness and contribute to the evolution of regional commercial strategy. Recruit, mentor, and develop high-potential sales professionals and build the next generation of regional sales leadership. Requirements: 10+ years of sales management experience, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding enterprise-level revenue targets. Demonstrated experience leading strategic enterprise sales teams, preferably within a growing or scaling technology business. Experience developing and executing regional or national strategic sales plans and delivering measurable results within budget and timelines. Strong knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies, particularly MEDDPICC and Force Management, with practical experience applying them to deal coaching and execution. Ability to develop client-focused, differentiated, and commercially achievable solutions that address complex enterprise needs. Exceptional ability to communicate, present, negotiate, and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels, including executive and C-suite audiences. Strong strategic thinking, business judgment, prioritization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance long-term growth with immediate execution. Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships across organizational boundaries and create strong internal and external networks. jobgether-jobgether:lever:83842bc7-3c91-.title: iOS developer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:83842bc7-3c91-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an iOS Developer based in Brazil. This role offers the opportunity to build and evolve high-quality iOS applications used by a large global audience. You will join an engineering environment focused on creating engaging, reliable, and user-friendly mobile experiences. Working closely with product and development teams, you will contribute throughout the application lifecycle, from feature planning and implementation to testing, release, and ongoing support. You will also help modernize existing applications and identify opportunities to improve performance, quality, and usability. The role suits a developer who combines strong Swift and Objective-C expertise with solid engineering fundamentals and a passion for mobile technology. You will work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your ideas can directly influence the evolution of mobile products. Develop, maintain, and enhance fully functional iOS applications using clean, scalable, and maintainable code. Design and implement new mobile features in collaboration with product and engineering teams. Create and execute unit tests and UI tests to identify defects and ensure application reliability. Support the complete application lifecycle, including requirements analysis, development, testing, release, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance. Analyze product requirements, identify technical solutions, and recommend improvements that enhance the overall user experience. Debug and optimize mobile applications to improve performance, stability, responsiveness, and usability. Collaborate with the Product Development team to plan, prioritize, and deliver new functionality. Maintain legacy applications and identify opportunities to improve, modernize, or replace outdated components. Ensure applications comply with established engineering, quality, and performance standards. Research emerging mobile technologies, frameworks, tools, and development practices and assess their potential value. Contribute ideas for new features, applications, integrations, and technical approaches that can improve the mobile product experience. Requirements 2+ years of professional experience working as an iOS Developer or in a closely related mobile development role. Demonstrated experience publishing mobile applications through the Apple App Store. Strong proficiency in Swift and Objective-C. Hands-on experience working with third-party libraries, SDKs, and APIs. Solid understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate technical issues and develop effective solutions. Good understanding of mobile application development, testing, debugging, and performance optimization. Strong teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a dynamic development environment. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline preferred. Ability to work effectively with distributed teams across multiple time zones. Experience with chat or streaming applications is a plus. Familiarity with mobile analytics and tracking tools, such as Firebase Analytics, is advantageous. Experience with WebRTC is a plus. Familiarity with WebSocket-based communication is advantageous. Strong UI/UX awareness and a good eye for mobile interface quality are desirable. Passion for mobile platforms and an interest in keeping up with evolving technologies and development trends. Benefits Opportunity to develop mobile applications serving a large global user base. Collaborative engineering environment with close interaction with product and development teams. Involvement across the full iOS application lifecycle, from concept through production support. Opportunity to work on new features while also improving and modernizing exist

The PI Behavioral Assessment isnot a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Commissions are paid every pay period - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service!
